title: SSVEP MAMEM 1 dataset
description: This dataset comprises 256-channel EEG recordings from 11 healthy subjects performing a steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface task. Subjects attended to flickering visual stimuli at five different frequencies (6.66–12.00 Hz) across multiple trials, with a total of 1,104 trials collected. The dataset supports comparative evaluation of signal processing algorithms and classification methods for SSVEP-based BCIs, including feature extraction techniques, spatial filtering, and machine learning classifiers.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 256-channel EGI Geodesic EEG System (GES 300) with HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net montage at a sampling rate of 250 Hz. Subjects focused attention on a violet flickering box presented at five frequencies (6.66, 7.50, 8.57, 10.00, 12.00 Hz) for 5-second trials followed by 5-second rest periods, with 3 repetitions per frequency and 30-second inter-frequency rest intervals. Visual stimuli were presented on a 1680×1080 pixel LCD monitor (60 Hz refresh rate) using Microsoft Visual Studio 2010 with OpenGL. Leave-one-subject-out cross-validation was employed for algorithm evaluation.
